# {{ r.name }}

> Personal portfolio of {{ r.name }}: software engineering (C#/.NET, Java, TypeScript), data engineering and analytics (Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, SQL, Python), and research in applied mathematics (mathematical modelling, scientific computing) with teaching. The site is in French (at the root) and English (under /en/). Portfolio personnel, en français à la racine et en anglais sous /en/.

The site has three independent spaces, one per career track, each with its experience, projects, skills, education, certifications, a contact page and a generated CV (PDF). The portal at the root lists the three spaces.
